title: Pullback preserves K-flat complexes
statement: Let $f:(X,\mathcal O_X)\to(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$ be a morphism of ringed spaces, consisting of a continuous map $f:X\to Y$ and a morphism of sheaves of rings $f^\sharp:\mathcal O_Y\to f_*\mathcal O_X$, with adjoint map $f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal O_X$. For a complex $K^\bullet$ of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules, let $f^*K^\bullet$ be the termwise pullback $f^{-1}K^\bullet\otimes_{f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y}\mathcal O_X$ using inverse image [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] with its canonical module structure [def-pc-topological-inverse-image-module] and sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. If $K^\bullet$ is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex], then $f^*K^\bullet$ is K-flat over $\mathcal O_X$.

proof.text: Fix $x\in X$ and put $y=f(x)$, $A=\mathcal O_{Y,y}$ and $B=\mathcal O_{X,x}$, with ring map $A\to B$ induced by $f^\sharp$. The natural inverse-image stalk isomorphisms identify $(f^{-1}K^n)_x$ with $K^n_y$ and $(f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y)_x$ with $A$ [lem-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image-stalk]. Applying the natural change-of-rings tensor-stalk isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-stalk-change-of-rings-tensor] degreewise to the definition of $f^*$ identifies $(f^*K^\bullet)_x$ with $K_y^\bullet\otimes_A B$ as a complex, including the differentials by naturality.

source.place: Cohomology, Lemma Tag 06YC (label lemma-pullback-K-flat), citing Lemma Tag 06YB (label lemma-check-K-flat-stalks)

proof.text: Let $L^\bullet$ be any acyclic complex of $B$-modules. Forgetting the $B$-action leaves an acyclic $A$-complex, since kernels and images of its differentials are the same additive subgroups. Associativity of tensor products, with the total-complex direct sums, gives $\operatorname{Tot}(L^\bullet\otimes_B(K_y^\bullet\otimes_A B))\cong\operatorname{Tot}(L^\bullet\otimes_A K_y^\bullet)$. The latter is acyclic by the K-flatness from step 2. Thus $K_y^\bullet\otimes_A B$ is K-flat over $B$ by definition [def-pc-kflat-complex]. This is the two-line base-change argument of Stacks Tag 06Y1; no flatness of $A\to B$ is required.

proof.text: Steps 1 and 3 show that $(f^*K^\bullet)_x$ is K-flat over $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ for every $x\in X$. The reverse implication of [lem-pc-kflat-stalk-criterion] on $X$ gives that $f^*K^\bullet$ is K-flat over $\mathcal O_X$.
